source_order_adapter.known_curve_order: Cs=C1s cat C2s cat C3s, with 32 C1 curves, 12 C2 curves, 48 C3 curves; hence 92 known curves before the 48 singular points.
source_order_adapter.exceptional_order: The pairing matrix appends pts[1]..pts[48] after the 92 known curves, so the last 48 all140 pairings are the exact source-side singular-point/exceptional sequence.

divisor_mass_adapter.relation: On the minimal resolution, the pullback of the canonical hyperplane b_j=0 is the sum of the four strict-transform C2 components in that group plus the 16 exceptional curves over the corresponding inertia nodes.

h2_capacity_test.principle: For h=2 the full component stabilizer M has order4 and contains exactly two of the three single-sign inertia elements; the third inertia class cannot ramify. Since Q>=188, the total contact mass on the two allowed classes must be at least188.
h2_capacity_test.unique_surviving_h2_stabilizer: M=<u-sign,v-sign>, H=M∩G0plus=<uv>; w-sign/b3=0 is the forbidden inertia class.

h2_parity_gate.required_exact_condition: Every V6 exceptional pairing on the 16 b3=0 nodes is even, because q_i=0 and q_i congruent m_i mod2.
h2_parity_gate.decision_rule: If any one of the 16 b3=0 V6 pairings is odd then h=2 is excluded and h=4 is forced at the component-stabilizer layer.

exact_missing_adapter.reduced_missing_object: Identify the 16 source-side pts[k]/EXC_k lying on b3=0, or equivalently certify parity of V6 intersections with those 16 exceptional curves individually.
exact_missing_adapter.why_not_guessed: Magma Points(SingularSubscheme(S)) source ordering is retained, but no audited compact locator mapping its 48 indices to b1/b2/b3 zero classes was found in the repository during this batch.
exact_missing_adapter.reopen_condition: Obtain a compact exact pts-index coordinate/inertia table from the verification source or an equivalent Picard/incidence adapter; do not whole-fetch denylisted retained Picard payloads.

exit.branch_exclusion_candidate: Two of the three h=2 component-stabilizer/inertia choices are excluded by exact class-mass capacity; only the subgroup forbidding w-sign/b3=0 survives.
